description: This is a PHP source file defining an API endpoint class 'LeaveBalanceAPI' which handles requests related to leave balances within a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving leave balance details for specific leave types and employees, as well as generating leave breakdowns over date ranges. The class also manages dependencies on services and other models related to leave management.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Leave\Api\LeaveBalanceAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling leave balance retrieval and breakdowns, encompassing authentication, validation, and interaction with leave services.

methods.name: getLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LeaveApplicationService used for leave data operations.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdParam
methods.description: Extracts and returns the leave type ID parameter from the request.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the start date parameter for leave balance query from the request.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the end date parameter for leave balance query from the request.

methods.name: getDurationParam
methods.description: Fetches an array-based duration parameter from the request for flexible date range or duration inputs.

methods.name: getPartialOptionParam
methods.description: Obtains optional partial option parameter, potentially influencing response granularity.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch leave balance for a specific leave type and employee, with optional date ranges. Returns normalized leave balance data along with metadata like employee and leave type details.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Converts a LeaveType entity into a normalized array suitable for API response.

methods.name: getNormalizedLeaveBalanceResult
methods.description: Processes leave period breakdowns to produce a normalized leave balance response, including period details, overall balance, and individual leave entries, marking negative balances.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdownForAppliedDateRange
methods.description: Generates detailed leave breakdowns over a date range, segmenting leave days into periods and marking holidays/weekends.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period object for a specific date, employee, and leave type, based on entitlement strategies.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET leave balance request, including optional employee number and date parameters.
